reason: Not trained - validated labelled dataset required. No genuine, per-sample honey laboratory dataset with reference-lab or expert-verified class labels could be verified. The standards-based compliance check runs without it.

investigated.source: Aykas D.P. (2023) Determination of Possible Adulteration and Quality Assessment in Commercial Honey. Foods 12(3):523. doi:10.3390/foods12030523 (PMC9914500), 147 commercial honeys
investigated.finding: Earlier HoneyChain review of the article: data availability 'Data is contained within the article'; only summary statistics (min/max/mean/SD) and calibration statistics; no per-sample table or supplementary data file; its only classes are 'pure' vs 'suspicious (sucrose > 5%)', i.e. a regulatory threshold rule. Re-check on 2026-11-23 failed (PMC served a bot-check page, MDPI returned HTTP 403, Europe PMC returned HTTP 500), so the earlier finding stands unverified-again.
investigated.decision: Unsuitable: no per-sample data; threshold-derived labels would only re-learn the standards rule.

investigated.source: Huyop F. (2026) Raw Data for Physicochemical, Antioxidant, and Sugar Composition Analyses of Selected Southeast Asian Honey Samples. Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.20072146
investigated.finding: One .xlsx file (12.8 kB) of triplicate measurements (sugars incl. fructose/glucose/sucrose/maltose, phenolics, flavonoids, DPPH) for honeys from 4 named origins. Samples are labelled by geographic origin only; no quality/compliance/authenticity labels; HMF and free acidity not listed.
investigated.decision: Unsuitable for a quality/compliance classifier: no verified quality labels, very few samples.

investigated.source: Other candidates seen in search (Zenodo 5717670 FTIR/PLS honey quality; Mendeley 6kxjzpkdvd Tanzanian honey; Zenodo 7844557 Butembo honey; Romanian acacia honey study PMC7691509)
investigated.finding: Not verified as downloadable per-sample tables with reference-lab or expert class labels (PMC7691509 full text could not be retrieved: Europe PMC HTTP 500).
investigated.decision: Not used. Can be re-evaluated with train_quality.py if a per-sample labelled file is obtained.

required_data: A CSV with one row per honey sample (or per replicate plus a sample id): at least 60 rows, at least 2 classes with >= 10 rows each, >= 10 distinct sample ids, >= 3 of moisture_pct, hmf_mg_kg, sucrose_g_100g, glucose_g_100g, fructose_g_100g, free_acidity_meq_kg, electrical_conductivity_ms_cm, ph, brix, water_activity, and a class label from a reference method (e.g. isotope/NMR authenticity result) or an expert panel - NOT derived from the same regulatory limits the standards check applies.
